import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({'pdf.fonttype': 42, 'ps.fonttype': 42})

C_H7a = '#D55E00'
C_H7b = '#CC79A7'
C_H1 = '#E69F00'
C_H8 = '#56B4E9'
C_GENUINE = '#009E73'
C_OTHER = '#999999'

conditions = [
    'ISR $\\beta$=0.3',
    'ISR $\\beta$=0.1',
    'Random $\\beta$=0.3',
    'Random $\\beta$=0.1',
    'Exec-only',
    'SFT',
]

# Pooled raw counts per condition (all seeds merged)
# Order: ISR b0.3, ISR b0.1, Random b0.3, Random b0.1, Exec-only, SFT
raw = {
    'h1':      [14,  42, 105, 187, 166,  3],
    'h7a':     [ 0, 161,   7,  36,  90,  0],
    'h7b':     [ 0,   2,   0,   0,   0,  0],
    'h8':      [ 3,  12,   0,  21,  21,  0],
    'genuine': [ 1,  14,   3,  25,   7, 36],
}

totals = [sum(raw[k][i] for k in raw) for i in range(len(conditions))]

h1      = [raw['h1'][i]      / totals[i] * 100 for i in range(len(conditions))]
h7a     = [raw['h7a'][i]     / totals[i] * 100 for i in range(len(conditions))]
h7b     = [raw['h7b'][i]     / totals[i] * 100 for i in range(len(conditions))]
h8      = [raw['h8'][i]      / totals[i] * 100 for i in range(len(conditions))]
genuine = [raw['genuine'][i] / totals[i] * 100 for i in range(len(conditions))]

y = np.arange(len(conditions))
bar_h = 0.55

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))

kw = dict(height=bar_h, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

left = np.zeros(len(conditions))
ax.barh(y, h7a, left=left, color=C_H7a, label='H7a (tautological)', **kw)
left += h7a
ax.barh(y, h7b, left=left, color=C_H7b, label='H7b (ISR-specific)', **kw)
left += h7b
ax.barh(y, h1, left=left, color=C_H1, label='H1 (shortcut)', **kw)
left += h1
ax.barh(y, h8, left=left, color=C_H8, label='H8 (degenerate)', **kw)
left += h8
ax.barh(y, genuine, left=left, color=C_GENUINE, label='Genuine', **kw)
left += genuine

for i, g in enumerate(genuine):
    ax.text(left[i] + 1.2, y[i], f'{g:.1f}%', va='center', ha='left',
            fontsize=9, color=C_GENUINE)

# Annotation: ISR β=0.1 H7 vs Random β=0.1 H7
isr_h7 = h7a[1] + h7b[1]
rand_h7 = h7a[3] + h7b[3]
ax.annotate(
    f'ISR H7: {isr_h7:.1f}%\nvs Random: {rand_h7:.1f}%',
    xy=(rand_h7 / 2, y[3]),
    xytext=(60, y[2] + 0.55),
    fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C_H7a,
    ha='center',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_H7a, lw=1.5),
)

ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels(conditions, fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel('Percentage of proved samples (%)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(0, 112)
ax.set_xticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc='lower right', frameon=False, ncol=2)

fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.22, right=0.95, top=0.92, bottom=0.14)

base = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_3/projects/solver-trace-ablation/paper/figures/fig3_hacking_composition'
fig.savefig(f'{base}.pdf', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
fig.savefig(f'{base}.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {base}.pdf')
print(f'Saved: {base}.png')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({'pdf.fonttype': 42, 'ps.fonttype': 42})

C_FOL = '#0072B2'
C_PROLOG = '#56B4E9'
C_H7 = '#D55E00'
C_DEGEN = '#E69F00'
C_QUERY = '#CC79A7'

seeds = ['s42', 's43', 's44']
x = np.arange(len(seeds))
bar_w = 0.32

fol_isr = [0.132, 0.000, 0.582]
prolog_isr = [0.037, 0.015, 0.387]
fol_pr = [93, 14, 98]
prolog_pr = [83, 56, 21]

h7 = [100, 0, 0]
degen = [0, 100, 0]
query = [0, 0, 100]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'wspace': 0.35})

# === Left Panel ===
b1 = ax1.bar(x - bar_w/2, fol_isr, bar_w, color=C_FOL, label='FOL', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
b2 = ax1.bar(x + bar_w/2, prolog_isr, bar_w, color=C_PROLOG, label='Prolog', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

# PR labels — handle s43 overlap by staggering vertically
pr_label_cfg = [
    # (fol_offset, prolog_offset) vertical nudge from bar top
    (0.018, 0.018),   # s42: bars well separated
    (0.055, 0.018),   # s43: FOL=0 Prolog=0.015, stagger FOL higher
    (0.018, 0.018),   # s44: bars well separated
]

for i, (bar, pr) in enumerate(zip(b1, fol_pr)):
    label = f'PR={pr}%'
    if i == 1:
        label += '†'
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + pr_label_cfg[i][0],
             label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color=C_FOL)

for i, (bar, pr) in enumerate(zip(b2, prolog_pr)):
    label = f'PR={pr}%'
    if i == 2:
        label = f'PR={pr}% ($n$=21)'
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + pr_label_cfg[i][1],
             label, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, color='#3a7abf')

ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(seeds, fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('ISR* (exec-only)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 0.75)
ax1.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 0.8, 0.1))
ax1.legend(fontsize=10, loc='upper left', frameon=False)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax1.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)
ax1.set_title('(a) Exec-only ISR*: FOL vs Prolog', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=8)

ax1.text(0.02, -0.13, '†s43 FOL: sampling T = 0.7, not strictly comparable',
         transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=7.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#555555')

# === Right Panel ===
bw2 = bar_w * 1.6
b_h7 = ax2.bar(x, h7, bw2, color=C_H7, label='H7 tautological', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
b_degen = ax2.bar(x, degen, bw2, bottom=h7, color=C_DEGEN, label='Degenerate syntax', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
b_query = ax2.bar(x, query, bw2, bottom=[h+d for h,d in zip(h7, degen)], color=C_QUERY, label='Query-as-fact', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)

ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(seeds, fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 125)
ax2.set_yticks([0, 25, 50, 75, 100])
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax2.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=10)
ax2.set_title('(b) Prolog STA Gaming Modes', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=8)

# Annotation below title
ax2.text(1.0, 115, '3/3 seeds gaming, 0% genuine — universal Goodhart',
         ha='center', fontsize=8.5, fontstyle='italic', color=C_H7)

# Legend: horizontal below figure
ax2.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc='lower center', frameon=False, ncol=3,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.22))

# Mode labels inside bars
mode_labels = ['H7\ntautol.', 'Degen.\nsyntax', 'Query-\nas-fact']
colors_text = ['white', 'black', 'white']
for i, (lbl, ct) in enumerate(zip(mode_labels, colors_text)):
    ax2.text(x[i], 50, lbl, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color=ct)

fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.22, top=0.88, left=0.08, right=0.97)

out_pdf = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_3/projects/solver-trace-ablation/paper/figures/fig4_prolog_comparison.pdf'
out_png = out_pdf.replace('.pdf', '.png')
fig.savefig(out_pdf, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.15)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {out_pdf}')
print(f'Saved: {out_png}')

28	def rolling_mean(arr, w=20):
29	    kernel = np.ones(w) / w
30	    padded = np.concatenate([np.full(w - 1, arr[0]), arr])
31	    return np.convolve(padded, kernel, mode="valid")
32

34	data_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "fig2_data.json")
35	with open(data_path) as f:
36	    data = json.load(f)

41	exec_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["exec_s44"]["isr"]), W)
42	
43	isr_s44_steps = np.array(data["isr_s44"]["steps"])
44	isr_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["isr_s44"]["isr"]), W)

46	isr_1k_steps = np.array(data["isr_s42_1000"]["steps"])
47	isr_1k_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["isr_s42_1000"]["isr"]), W)

50	rand_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["random_s44"]["isr"]), W)
51

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Fig 5: Training ISR curves across reward conditions — meta-Goodhart gaming."""

import json
import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OI_BLUE = "#0072B2"
OI_RED  = "#D55E00"
OI_SKY  = "#56B4E9"
OI_GREY = "#999999"

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 8,
    "axes.titlesize": 9, "axes.labelsize": 8,
    "xtick.labelsize": 7.5, "ytick.labelsize": 7.5,
    "legend.fontsize": 7, "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300, "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.03,
    "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.4, "pdf.fonttype": 42, "ps.fonttype": 42,
})


def rolling_mean(arr, w=20):
    kernel = np.ones(w) / w
    padded = np.concatenate([np.full(w - 1, arr[0]), arr])
    return np.convolve(padded, kernel, mode="valid")


data_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "fig2_data.json")
with open(data_path) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

W = 20

exec_s44_steps = np.array(data["exec_s44"]["steps"])
exec_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["exec_s44"]["isr"]), W)

isr_s44_steps = np.array(data["isr_s44"]["steps"])
isr_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["isr_s44"]["isr"]), W)

isr_1k_steps = np.array(data["isr_s42_1000"]["steps"])
isr_1k_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["isr_s42_1000"]["isr"]), W)

rand_s44_steps = np.array(data["random_s44"]["steps"])
rand_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["random_s44"]["isr"]), W)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 2.4))

ax.plot(isr_s44_steps, isr_s44_smooth, color=OI_RED, linewidth=1.6,
        label=r"ISR $\beta\!=\!0.1$ (s44)", zorder=5)
ax.plot(isr_1k_steps, isr_1k_smooth, color=OI_RED, linewidth=1.0,
        alpha=0.5, linestyle="--",
        label=r"ISR $\beta\!=\!0.1$ (s42, 1k)", zorder=4)

ax.plot(exec_s44_steps, exec_s44_smooth, color=OI_BLUE, linewidth=1.6,
        label="Exec-only (s44)", zorder=5)

ax.plot(rand_s44_steps, rand_s44_smooth, color=OI_SKY, linewidth=1.6,
        label=r"Random $\beta\!=\!0.1$ (s44)", zorder=5)

collapse_step = 280
collapse_isr = isr_s44_smooth[collapse_step - 1]
ax.annotate("Meta-Goodhart\ngaming",
            xy=(collapse_step, collapse_isr),
            xytext=(80, 0.92),
            fontsize=6.5, color=OI_RED, fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=OI_RED, lw=0.8,
                            connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.2"),
            ha="center", va="center")

ax.annotate("H7a artifact",
            xy=(350, exec_s44_smooth[349]),
            xytext=(430, 0.65),
            fontsize=6, color=OI_BLUE, fontstyle="italic",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=OI_BLUE, lw=0.7,
                            connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.2"),
            ha="center", va="center")

ax.set_xlabel("Training Step")
ax.set_ylabel("Training ISR (rolling mean, $w$=20)")
ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1050)
ax.legend(loc="center right", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="#CCCCCC",
          fontsize=6.5, handlelength=1.2, borderpad=0.3)
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linewidth=0.5)

out_dir = os.path.dirname(__file__)
for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
    out = os.path.join(out_dir, f"fig5_training_isr_curves.{ext}")
    fig.savefig(out, format=ext)
    print(f"Saved: {out}")
plt.close()

OI_SKY  = "#56B4E9"
OI_GREY = "#999999"

plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 8,
    "axes.titlesize": 9, "axes.labelsize": 9,
    "xtick.labelsize": 8, "ytick.labelsize": 8,
    "legend.fontsize": 8, "figure.dpi": 300,
    "savefig.dpi": 300, "savefig.bbox": "tight",
    "savefig.pad_inches": 0.03,
    "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 1.4, "pdf.fonttype": 42, "ps.fonttype": 42,
})


def rolling_mean(arr, w=20):
    kernel = np.ones(w) / w
    padded = np.concatenate([np.full(w - 1, arr[0]), arr])
    return np.convolve(padded, kernel, mode="valid")


data_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "fig2_data.json")
with open(data_path) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

W = 20

exec_s44_steps = np.array(data["exec_s44"]["steps"])
exec_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["exec_s44"]["isr"]), W)

isr_s44_steps = np.array(data["isr_s44"]["steps"])
isr_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["isr_s44"]["isr"]), W)

isr_1k_steps = np.array(data["isr_s42_1000"]["steps"])
isr_1k_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["isr_s42_1000"]["isr"]), W)

rand_s44_steps = np.array(data["random_s44"]["steps"])
rand_s44_smooth = rolling_mean(np.array(data["random_s44"]["isr"]), W)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.25, 2.4))

ax.plot(isr_s44_steps, isr_s44_smooth, color=OI_RED, linewidth=1.6,
        label=r"ISR $\beta\!=\!0.1$ (s44)", zorder=5)
ax.plot(isr_1k_steps, isr_1k_smooth, color=OI_RED, linewidth=1.0,
        alpha=0.5, linestyle="--",
        label=r"ISR $\beta\!=\!0.1$ (s42, 1k)", zorder=4)

ax.plot(exec_s44_steps, exec_s44_smooth, color=OI_BLUE, linewidth=1.6,
        label="Exec-only (s44)", zorder=5)

ax.plot(rand_s44_steps, rand_s44_smooth, color=OI_SKY, linewidth=1.6,
        label=r"Random $\beta\!=\!0.1$ (s44)", zorder=5)

collapse_step = 280
collapse_isr = isr_s44_smooth[collapse_step - 1]
ax.annotate("Meta-Goodhart\ngaming",
            xy=(collapse_step, collapse_isr),
            xytext=(80, 0.92),
            fontsize=8, color=OI_RED, fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=OI_RED, lw=0.8,
                            connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.2"),
            ha="center", va="center")

ax.annotate("H7a artifact",
            xy=(350, exec_s44_smooth[349]),
            xytext=(430, 0.65),
            fontsize=8, color=OI_BLUE, fontstyle="italic",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=OI_BLUE, lw=0.7,
                            connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.2"),
            ha="center", va="center")

ax.set_xlabel("Training Step")
ax.set_ylabel("Training ISR (rolling mean, $w$=20)")
ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1050)
ax.legend(loc="center right", framealpha=0.9, edgecolor="#CCCCCC",
          fontsize=6.5, handlelength=1.2, borderpad=0.3)
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linewidth=0.5)

out_dir = os.path.dirname(__file__)
for ext in ("pdf", "png"):
    out = os.path.join(out_dir, f"fig5_training_isr_curves.{ext}")
    fig.savefig(out, format=ext)
    print(f"Saved: {out}")
plt.close()
